programme.desc: Receiving a humiliating demotion to traffic duty, Chan decides to take a vacation with girlfriend May. However, when terrorists threaten Hong Kong, he abort his vacation plans..

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 四千金
programme.desc: The Cheng sisters, Li-fang and Li-chiung, leave war-torn Shanghai for Hong Kong. Li-chiung is rescued from robbers by Chien Pei-ling who decides to try out her luck in Hong Kong with the Chengs. They join Uncle and Aunt in Hong Kong. And they get along wonderfully with the daughter Cheng Hsiao-chuan. Li-chiung falls in love with Tony and elopes. That casts the first shadows on the friendships. It's Li-fang's turn to fall in love but both times Pei-ling steals her men. Hsiao-chuan meets Robert. A distraught Li-fang takes out a tutoring job in Macao where she falls in love. Pei-ling loves the same man..

programme.title: 福星高照
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: Foon, a Public Relations manager, starts a happy life with his wife Ann after remarrying her. Kwan, a new public relation officer in Foon's department, falls in love with Foon after he shields her from being criticized, when there is friction between Foon and Ann. Thus Foon falls in love with Kwan gradually. After a business trip to Tokyo, their relationship becomes much closer, while Ann meets Chu, a councilor, who falls in love with her but can't get Ann's response. When returning to Hong Kong, Kwan doesn't want to destroy Foon's family and decides to marry her fianc? When Foon is depressed by this, Ann finds out the truth. Another rupture breaks out again.

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 五個寂寞的心
programme.desc: This is a story about five sixteen years old girls...Yan, Celia, Maggie, Jacky and Kitty are five close friends, they live and study together. During their growing process, all of them have their own confusion. Yan meets Wai accidentally and being love with each other. Kitty is unhappy with her brother's new girlfriend, she wants to separate them then cause many incidents..

programme.title: 武俠「程」意結: 冒險王
programme.desc: “The Scripture With No Words” had been lost for a long time. Everybody was eager to find it, even the ambitious Japanese. Dr. Wai was antiquarian. Having seen the mysterious “Wooden Horse”, lost control and killing people, he quit his job. However, being supported by his friend, Dr. Wai recovered and resumed to his work. He went to Shanghai trying to locate “The Scripture With No Words” and he discovered that it was in the possession of the leader of “Gang of Salt”. And the game begin..

programme.title: 江湖龍虎鬥
programme.desc: Wing and Fat have the same burning ambition to be big in the underworld. They struggle and are doing very well, so well the kingpin of the gangs wants to get rid of them. Wing and Fat are forced to fight back, then the showdown comes..

programme.title: 跛豪
programme.desc: The story of Ho, a chinese peasant/slave worker who escapes to Hong Kong and becomes one of the most feared crime bosses in Hong Kong.

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 四千金
programme.desc: The Cheng sisters, Li-fang and Li-chiung, leave war-torn Shanghai for Hong Kong. Li-chiung is rescued from robbers by Chien Pei-ling who decides to try out her luck in Hong Kong with the Chengs. They join Uncle and Aunt in Hong Kong. And they get along wonderfully with the daughter Cheng Hsiao-chuan. Li-chiung falls in love with Tony and elopes. That casts the first shadows on the friendships. It's Li-fang's turn to fall in love but both times Pei-ling steals her men. Hsiao-chuan meets Robert. A distraught Li-fang takes out a tutoring job in Macao where she falls in love. Pei-ling loves the same man..

programme.title: 福星高照
programme.desc: Two Hong-Kong cops are sent to Tokyo to catch an ex-cop who stole a large amount of money in diamonds. After one is captured by the Ninja-gang protecting the rogue cop, the other one gets his old Orphanage gang, dubbed the 'Five Lucky Stars,' to help him. They don't like this much, but they do it..

programme.title: 中華英雄
programme.desc: Hero goes home with excited but he finds his parent was killed. Gian took a group of foreigners to Hero's parents and forced them to hand over the Red Sword, their family treasure..

programme.title: 錯在新宿
programme.desc: Foon, a Public Relations manager, starts a happy life with his wife Ann after remarrying her. Kwan, a new public relation officer in Foon's department, falls in love with Foon after he shields her from being criticized, when there is friction between Foon and Ann. Thus Foon falls in love with Kwan gradually. After a business trip to Tokyo, their relationship becomes much closer, while Ann meets Chu, a councilor, who falls in love with her but can't get Ann's response. When returning to Hong Kong, Kwan doesn't want to destroy Foon's family and decides to marry her fianc? When Foon is depressed by this, Ann finds out the truth. Another rupture breaks out again.

programme.title: 靈幻先生
programme.desc: One dark night, a charlatan Uncle Ming attempts to exorcise angry spirits in a haunted house but is unsuccessful and he narrowly escapes. He brings his two ghostly companions Ta Pao and Hsi Pao with him to a nearby town. The town is under attack by a group of bandits with supernatural powers. The thugs are led by Devil Lady, a powerful evil witch doctor. When Ming and the Paos are having dinner in a restaurant, Captain Chiang comes to harass them, and the Paos take revenge by playing tricks on Chiang. Just then, Chiang's master, Uncle Nine, appears and he subdues the two ghosts and traps them inside a wine jar. Ming pleads with Nine to release the Paos. Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..

programme.title: 呆佬拜壽
programme.desc: Ji Fu, the successor of Ji's family, becomes an idiot after being knocked out in an 'accident' created by the second-successor Ji Jack. After being an idiot, Fu meets Mon Tee..

programme.title: 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the Taiwanese group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk..

programme.title: 小親親
programme.desc: Zhang hosts a top radio program that offers advice regarding love affairs. He starts a love-war relationship with Wu, a columnist, when she hears him gossiping on her love life.

programme.title: 人嚇鬼
programme.desc: In a touring opera group, the domineering star is hated by all. The lesser actors try to give him a bad time by posing as ghosts. Their antics attract the attention of a real ghost who comes to make fun of them. Stage old hand Seng soon discovers the mischievous ghost met a violent death. Seng promises to find his remains and bury him. Unwittingly, Seng buries the wrong bones which belong to the Vicious Ghost. The Vicious Ghost comes and leaves a trail of violence..

programme.title: 西遊記之月光寶盒
programme.desc: At the foothills of Fingers Mountain, there is one Highwaymen's Haven, operating as a motel. The gang leader is a fellow named The Joker, and the gang makes a living out of robbing the traveling businessmen and scholars. The Joker is in fact Monkey King reincarnated. Grandpa Buddha is the only God who knows about this. Two of the devils, Spider Woman and Boney M, took the guise of Sharon Stone and Madonna and wooed him into betraying this secret. The two devils decided to get the Joker out of the way so that they could capture the Longevity Monk when the time came for his reincarnation..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲：武俠「程」意結: 西遊記之仙履奇緣
programme.desc: The Joker travels back in time to save his beloved, the reformed devil Boney M. But instead of the right place and right time, he finds himself stranded in five hundred years back..

programme.title: 帶子洪郎
programme.desc: Hung is a stuntman living with his troublesome father, Kwun. Five years ago, he deeply fell in love with May. Yet May's father strongly objected their relations and separated them trickily, with the help of Kwun. One day, May come backs - but with her six-year-old son, Sam. He begins to get back what he loses five years ago. May actually been badly ill before she comes back Hong Kong. Her only wish before die is to bring Sam back to Hung. After May has died, May's father insists to keep Sam by his sides. Hung tries his best to get back Sam. In order to earn more money, he does a very dangerous stunt. At last, he is injured..

programme.title: 夜驚魂
programme.desc: A cuckolded husband becomes a cross-dressing night stalker, compelled to strike down any women he sees wearing white fish-net stockings. Leaving a trail of dead bodies in his wake, he selects a female disc jockey as his next target..

programme.title: 太子傳說
programme.desc: Cheung is Prince, the son of crime boss Mr. Pak in the underworld. He kills flamboyantly with the help of partner Ching Ching, who was a gift from Mr. Pak many years ago. Still, despite Ching's constant companionship, Prince longs for a woman he has seen in his dreams since youth. The dream girl is a dancer Tweedy. He also longs to kill Drago, who was supposedly responsible for taking his mother away. Dragon actually has his own vendetta against Pak, as Pak kidnapped his son many years ago. The missing son turns up, and he's now a killer who goes by the name of Prince.

programme.title: 盲女七十二小時
programme.desc: Heung is temporarily blinded by an accident. While her doctor husband leaves Hong Kong for a meeting, an uninvited man arrives at their house. The man teases and tortures Heung, claiming that he is coming to avenge his wife..

programme.title: 賊王
programme.desc: Wisdom thief Ren Jiahua girlfriend Ann as an internal, using high-tech techniques robbed by the escort vehicle, have stolen money of one hundred and seventy thousand million. Crime Unit Chief Inspector Li Tiejian with detectives working around the clock to detect, eventually discover clues. Suspect that China and Ann is the mastermind of the case, but there is no evidence against. Lee tried various methods interrogations to no avail, Finally solely strict confession, but two willpower Jianli, tolerate the torture and recrimination Li officers tortured. Until the final drama, all the officers with ingenious ways, the two incriminating expose to justice.

programme.title: 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the Taiwanese group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk..

programme.title: 三人做世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex and Chu Lai Ngo, played by George Lam and Do Do Cheng, finally get married and live with Chu's daughter Vivian, played by Vivian Chow. Since the owner of the advertising company migrates, Alex starts to take control of the company. However, the company is forced to close down due to the banker goes bankrupt. Besides, Chu and Vivian both join a financial investment company owned by Alex's old classmate ET, acted by Paul Chun. Chu is promoted to be the Assistant of General Manager in a short period of time. Nevertheless, it is a fraud for Chu. Can Alex save his company from closing down and how does Alex help Chu run away from the fraud..

programme.title: 波牛
programme.desc: Country boy Lee Tong has the knack of getting into trouble with great regularity. But this time, he has to beat it all the way to the city. And the first thing that happens to him in the city is to have his pocket picked. In chasing the thief, Lee meets young girl Fanny and knocks out No.1 ball player King by accident. Fanny and her brother Suen take Lee in. The two boys decide to adopt soccer as their profession. The ball club owned by King employs Lee only because King wants to settle the score with the boy. Lee Tong suffers all kinds of humiliations. Yet he presses on..

programme.title: 著牛仔褲的鍾馗
programme.desc: Tsu, a police officer, has a happy life with his wife, who's pregnant. But one day when he gets a tip that a bank is about to be robbed, he rushes to it but killed. The hostage Gucci then holds the loot. Tsu becomes a vampire when a cat jumps on his body and is hit by lightning. Not until he went to the hospital did he realize he was dead and needs electric recharge to be alive. In order to keep his wife from being sad, he doesn't tell her the truth. Even when his best friend Mr. Big and Gucci find it out, he asks them to keep in secret. To get back the loot, the robbers seize both Gucci and Tsu's wife, forcing Tsu to bring the loot to exchange them..

programme.title: 四人新世界
programme.desc: Fei is the master cook in Hong Kong, while his son Suckling has established himself as a real estate salesman in Canada. Suckling sends for his father to join him in this new chapter of their lives. Happily, Fei hops on a plane to Canada. During the flight, he has the good fortune of meeting Yim Chau, a young woman traveling to join her aunt in Canada. Subsequently, Fei meets Yim Chau's aunt and Suckling meets Yim Chau. Suckling loves Yim Chau but is too shy to express his feelings. When Yim Chau announces she falls in love with Richard, Suckling feels heartbroken but still helps her with dating preparations. However, when he discovers Richard cheating her, Suckling fights him. At the same time, he is being chased by the bank for debts..

programme.title: 龍的心
programme.desc: It's the two brothers of Hong Kong action as you have never seen them before in a gripping drama where the lines blur between family loyalty and upholding the law. Jackie Chan plays Ted, a SWAT officer with thwarted dreams of being a sailor because he has to look after his mentally disabled brother Danny. The resentment boils over in a terse showdown between the two brothers. When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him.

programme.title: 逆天者
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Feng was an orphan. When he went on a date with a writer Zhi, Zhi died unexpectedly. After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed..

programme.title: 薰衣草
programme.desc: Athena is an aromatherapy tutor but can't heal up her wound at heart. One day, she finds a broken-wing angel falling on balcony. A scented romance is gradually in between them..

programme.title: 藍色霹靂火
programme.desc: Jody was a fashion model who was found dead in the apartment. Investigation of this murder case was taken up by Superintendent Ching, assisted by Dillon who had just passed from the Police Training School. They located Lam, Jody's ex-husband, who agreed to assist Ching after persuasion. They found Ellen, a fashion model who lived with Jody. She was not willing to talk. On the other side, the murderer is planning to kill Ellen..

programme.title: 應召女郎1988
programme.desc: A polyphonous and surprisingly complex portrayal of the lives of Hong Kong prostitutes, told through the eyes of several women of varying class and social standing whose lives are affected-directly and indirectly-by the world's oldest profession.

programme.title: 皇家師姐IV之直擊証人
programme.desc: A detective of the Anti-Narcotics Bureau is pursued for a film he snapped containing evidence of drug-trafficking between a CIA and Hong Kong drug traffickers. Before death, he hands the film over to a Hong Kong immigrant, a pier coolie Luk, who throws it away when the killer arrives. Hong Kong police Madam Yeung assigned to help the local police to investigate the case witnesses Luk killing a killer of the Intelligence Agency but concludes that he is innocent and did it out of defense only. Local detective Donnie and his sidekick Michael Wong are responsible for probing the murder, and when Luk escapes to Hong Kong, Donnie and Yeung immediately to Hong Kong to trace him. Donnie and Michael are also under orders to have him arrested and extradited to the USA. However, Luk and Michael have already been and abducted by the crafty killer..

programme.title: 影人映語 -點解「吳式」笑 － 吳君如
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer.

programme.title: 家有囍事
programme.desc: All's Well, Ends Well is a comic romance of 3 hapless brothers, who eventually learn through their amorous exploits and misadventures that love is only won through gradual nurturing, and quickly lost through the quick, dishonest, selfish ways which they have always taken for granted.

programme.title: 波牛

And the first thing that happens to him in the city is to have his pocket picked. In chasing the thief, Lee meets young girl Fanny and knocks out No.1 ball player King by accident. Fanny and her brother Suen take Lee in. The two boys decide to adopt soccer as their profession. The ball club owned by King employs Lee only because King wants to settle the score with the boy. Lee Tong suffers all kinds of humiliations. Yet he presses on..

Suckling loves Yim Chau but is too shy to express his feelings. When Yim Chau announces she falls in love with Richard, Suckling feels heartbroken but still helps her with dating preparations. However, when he discovers Richard cheating her, Suckling fights him. At the same time, he is being chased by the bank for debts..

programme.title: 影人映語 -葛來FUN多 - 葛民輝
programme.desc: Eric Kot's hilarious image has been widely recognized by Hong Kong audience on big-screen, particularly after portrayed the character of a zany assistant in ‘Tricky Business' and an attentive killer in ‘You Shoot, I Shoot'. Having years of acting experience, he has formed his own view of how to film a comedy. Apart from being in front of cameras, he had been invited by acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar-wai to participate his work at directorial role and encountered Asian star Takeshi Kaneshiro behind-the-scene. In this episode, Eric is going to tell his stories you might not know about.

programme.title: 幻影特攻
programme.desc: Two CIA researchers undergo 'VR Fighter training' in order to save a kidnapped colleague. The training is designed to change an unskilled agent into a magnificent combat agent.

programme.title: 黃飛鴻之二男兒當自強
programme.desc: During his stay in Canton, Wong Fei Hung meets Sun Yat Sun and Luke. He decides to help them escape by the 'cover' from the rioting White Lotus Sect.

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May..

programme.title: 藍色霹靂火
programme.desc: Jody was a fashion model who was found dead in the apartment. Investigation of this murder case was taken up by Superintendent Ching, assisted by Dillon who had just passed from the Police Training School. They located Lam, Jody's ex-husband, who agreed to assist Ching after persuasion. They found Ellen, a fashion model who lived with Jody. She was not willing to talk. On the other side, the murderer is planning to kill Ellen..

programme.title: 想飛
programme.desc: When Joker meets Ling in a disco one night, he feels she is the perfect model of his dream project 'princess-d'. In reality, however, Ling is the opposite of the perfect image..

programme.title: 情義心
programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. Chi-to's cousin, Chan, acts as a go-between and arranges a trafficking of counterfeit U.S. notes between Chi-to's group and the local triad society in Taiwan. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky..

programme.title: 八彩林亞珍
programme.desc: Jenny, with the plain looks but a heart of gold, she is always in between jobs. Once she gets a job, her knack of creating awkward situations immediately loses it for her. Fang is her suitor, but he gets nowhere as the girl has no time for love, so Fang goes along with her in job hunting. A big group called Sanda wants to take over the whole city through take-over deals. They are ruthless and have thrown thousands into the streets. Jenny and Fang, bungling as they are, become the vanguard of a movement against the great conglomerate. They were even being hunted by the group and their life was threatened..

programme.title: 星願
programme.desc: What if you are given a wish being the 60th billion person moving to 'Polaris' (or others call it 'Heaven'), will you do the same as Onion, who was blind and dumb when he's alive.

programme.title: 死亡遊戲
programme.desc: When Billy refuses to be intimidated by henchman Steiner, Dr. Land orders his assassination to serve as an example to others. Stick sneaks onto the set of Billy's new film...

programme.title: 我在黑社會的日子
programme.desc: Hung Hing Family boss Lee Qun was ambushed on his way to Macau. His heir Lee Mun-ho flew back from the States for the funeral. Mun-ho, who did not want to mingle with the mobsters, planned to return to the States for good after wrapping up his father's business in Hong Kong. However, through his intelligence and managerial skills, he turned Hung Hing into a well organized business structure. On the other hand, Yeung Kong, a young and ambitious mobster who was brought up under the old Triad tradition, strongly opposed Mun-ho..

programme.title: 生死線
programme.desc: The story takes place on a deserted island. The only residence on the island is a family in which the mother ruled over three of her sons: Tai Fat, gloomy and sullen; Yee Fat, vulgar and cruel; Sam Fat, slightly retarded. Mother's earnest wish is to find a wife for Sam Fat to continue the family tree. Teacher Cheung, along with six of his students arrive on the island for camping. They first meet Yee Fat who brings them to the grocery for a rest. Yee Fat is delighted with the presence of the 3 young girls while Sam Fat falls in love at first sight with the charming girl Phyllis. He expresses his feelings to Tai Fat who has sworn to his mother that he will fulfill her wish to find his youngest brother a wife. He proposes to Cheung that Phyllis be married to Sam Fat. Cheung first thinks that it's a joke, but soon senses that Tai Fat is serious and that all three brothers are actually psychologically imbalanced..

programme.title: 殭屍醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Chiang, a Hong Kong surgeon, finds himself surrounded by beautiful girls in an old castle. Little does he realize these are the Count's vampire girls. He has a one-night stand with Alice who bites him while he was unaware. He gradually assumes the characteristics of a vampire. Alice breaks with the Count and goes to Hong Kong to save Dr. Chiang. That gets him into hot water with his girlfriend May..

programme.title: 蠍子戰士
programme.desc: Fei comes to Hong Kong with his son Yushu and winds up a back-alley barber. Yushu is now in high school but he only likes to draw pictures. He also is hot blooded, thus often getting into fights. By accident, Yushu meets beautiful Ru. He learns that Inspector Hua and underworld boss Wang are working together in prostitution and human traffic. Yushu helps Ru to escape from Wang 's catches. Fei, Yushu and Ru are being haunted by Hua's men, but are saved by self-styled kungfu master Jean-Paul. They are taken in by Master Yi and asks Yushu to prepare the beef noodles but he only wants to learn kungfu from Jean-Paul. However, Yushu realizes Master Yi actually is the kungfu master. He begs Master Yi to teach him the skills and fight against evil forces together..

programme.title: 影人映語 -鐵骨闖江湖 - 錢小豪
programme.desc: Being a well-known martial art movie star, Chin Siu Ho talks about his stories and personal feelings from such long journey. When got into acting since childhood, Siu Ho reveals that the encounter with Chang Cheh and Sammo Hung were the benefactors of his acting life and how he went through the mill to make action movies in the ‘80s. In particular, he has recalled his injury and hardship at the set of Hong Kong classic action-comedy ‘Mr. Vampire' that one of the scenes simply had him retaken for eight times! To know about the behind-the-scene of Hong Kong ‘80s action movies, let Siu Ho tell you more in this episode.

programme.title: 雙城故事
programme.desc: After having grown up to lead wildly separate lives, two reunited boyhood pals pledge to maintain their friendship at all costs but both fall in love with the same woman.

programme.title: 壞女孩
programme.desc: The first thing on notices about Yau is his strong hatred for mahjong. He had good reasons: his mahjong-playing mother refused to leave the gaming table to attend to his father who had been robbed. The father died as the result, of course. Being young and fancy-free, Yau goes to the beach with two friends to see if romance should drop on him. It does, and like a ton of bricks because he sees and falls for the beautiful Fong. It so happen Fong is a devoted mahjong player, but she has a sister who hates mahjong, Yau goes all out. He is first snubbed but later comforted by Fong in a gymnasium where he helps her dodge arresting traffic policemen. Fong tries her best to cover her addiction to mahjong and awkward situations come on fast and furious..

programme.title: 殺手之王
programme.desc: With a box of worthless war bonds, an old man hired the King of Killers to assassinate a Japanese trade lord. In WWII, the trade lord's action had caused grave damage to the family of the King of Killers. He agrees to take the job and delivers in a few days. The Revenge Fund set up by the trade lord kicks in. Whoever avenges the trade lord's death, killing the killer and the force behind him, will receive a reward of $1 billion. The police assigns Inspector to watch the killers, with orders to leave them room when they kill each other. Among the killers vying for the reward are Fu, a new immigrant, and his agent, Wong a longtime loser trying to score a big one riding on Fu's coat-tail. After an elaborately orchestrated chain of events, Wong and Fu manage to accomplish their goal.

programme.title: 風雲雄霸天下
programme.desc: Nie Feng (Wind) and Bu Jingyun (Cloud) are raised by Xiong Ba of World Society, helping him to conquer the world. But Xiong Ba is their mutual enemy who killed their fathers..

programme.title: 嫁個有錢人
programme.desc: ME is embarked on her adventure to Europe to seek a wealthy husband, and she runs into ravishing DAN. Can she find true happiness and her glass high-heeled shoes as Cinderella did.

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: A Dying man is leaving behind him a no good son, a very good daughter, a scheming nephew, a vast fortune and a will which bequeaths everything to the daughter. So the scheming nephew gets Tricky star to steal the will in order to alter it. The son is not idle either. He finds Phoenix, a garbage collector, to pose as the absent daughter who looks the same as Phoenix. Phoenix files into Hong Kong and gets into the house in great pomp. She also surprises a thieving Tricky Star, who immediately assumes the role of a suitor. That pleases Phoenix immensely..

programme.title: 賭俠大戰拉斯維加斯
programme.desc: The story to after The Conman, where Dragon's sister Ching went to study in Canada. After King and Dragon defeated Macau Mon, they became swindling partners..

programme.title: 皇家女將
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: 蔣英實
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

programme.desc: Paddy and Chris head to Sweden to get back to nature and embody 'friluftsliv'. It can lower stress and improve mental health, but can they embrace nature to get the reboot needed.

programme.desc: In the footsteps of Livingstone and Stanley, Ben Fogle and Dwayne Fields try to solve one of history's greatest mysteries, setting out to find the Nile's source, travelling through deadly jungles and swamps.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A 44-ton Artic straddling the central reservation of the M1 is a rush hour headache for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve and one of the youngest Recovery Ops on the team, Pat. Down South, Lantern Recovery op Steve rescues a broken down 26-ton dustcart from a busy London street. Crouch Recovery op Jim gets drenched as he risks life and limb trying to get a broken-down tractor back to its farm – just a hundred yards away! And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In this food-filled episode, Catfish throws up all over the world. The biking duo try various forms of genitalia including bull testicle, tiger and sea penis, virgin eggs, otherwise known as pee billed eggs, and more. They try duck head in China and worm tequila and mosquito eggs in Mexico. The question becomes, can you keep it down while watching this special episode.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Catfish and Rooftop go on a mission with the Colombian military's anti-narcotics division, test bulletproof clothing on themselves and experience the most painful insect sting in the world.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.desc: After a morning on the Bayou, the Duck Camp Dinners crew enjoy a fresh cooked dinner while discussing the changing coastal wetlands of Louisiana. Jean-Paul gets to finally a hunt an area he had only heard about as a young man, and takes in the beauty of the live cypress trees this camp is known for.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.desc: After a late night of good times, venison chili, and some old school roux the crew heads out for another day of hunting ducks. Adaptability is critical, and after a couple of quick adjustments the team finds themselves back in the ducks.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Rob Brydon 第1季
programme.desc: Funny man Rob Brydon joins Bear Grylls for an adventure he won’t forget as he takes on a mission in the Mountains of Snowdonia.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Anthony Joshua 第1季
programme.desc: Adventurer Bear Grylls teaches the unified world heavyweight champion some alternative survival skills.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A 44-ton Artic straddling the central reservation of the M1 is a rush hour headache for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve and one of the youngest Recovery Ops on the team, Pat. Down South, Lantern Recovery op Steve rescues a broken down 26-ton dustcart from a busy London street. Crouch Recovery op Jim gets drenched as he risks life and limb trying to get a broken-down tractor back to its farm – just a hundred yards away! And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Warwick Davis 第1季
programme.desc: Legendary actor Warwick Davis is on a Mission with Bear Grylls in the mountains of the Lake District.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Beauty and the Reef 第1季
programme.desc:
This is a crucial documentary told by those who have lived and breathed
every facet of this reef and been the advocates long before people understood
the changes..
The vision of 10,000 dives through the producer half of these on the Great
Barrier reef to provide the avenue of understanding of change.
The knowledge of one of the worlds leading marine biologist who has spent
his life in the water and advised governments on upcoming changes is world
class..
Lin Sutherland has published hundreds of article on the marine environment,
has been a photographer, videographer and passionate advocate who has
always understood the journey of the Great barrier reef, few people have the
insight into this ecosystem like her.
This will be a film of a lifetime.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

Down South, Lantern Recovery op Steve rescues a broken down 26-ton dustcart from a busy London street. Crouch Recovery op Jim gets drenched as he risks life and limb trying to get a broken-down tractor back to its farm – just a hundred yards away! And Lantern’s night shift recovery op Jason faces a battle to rescue an articulated lorry that’s crashed down a steep ditch off the A1.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: An overturned Gas tanker full of highly flammable propane mean trouble for Crouch Recovery Incident Manager Steve. Working with the fire service he must all his experience to keep his team out of danger. Meanwhile with very little room to manoeuvre Lantern recovery op Steve must rescue a 44-ton artic stuck in a ditch on a busy five lane roundabout. And Lantern Recovery Op Sean has thought on his feet to break into an abandoned truck.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Warwick Davis 第1季
programme.desc: Legendary actor Warwick Davis is on a Mission with Bear Grylls in the mountains of the Lake District.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: Andy and Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Beauty and the Reef 第1季
programme.desc:
This is a crucial documentary told by those who have lived and breathed
every facet of this reef and been the advocates long before people understood
the changes..
The vision of 10,000 dives through the producer half of these on the Great
Barrier reef to provide the avenue of understanding of change.
The knowledge of one of the worlds leading marine biologist who has spent
his life in the water and advised governments on upcoming changes is world
class..
Lin Sutherland has published hundreds of article on the marine environment,
has been a photographer, videographer and passionate advocate who has
always understood the journey of the Great barrier reef, few people have the
insight into this ecosystem like her.
This will be a film of a lifetime.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral 第1季
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Wild Fed 第1季
programme.desc: Daniel navigates the rugged terrain of mountain stream beds to fish wild brook trout and forage milkweed flowers for a camp meal hard won from the wild.

programme.title: Wild Fed 第1季
programme.desc: Far from the urban jungle, Daniel teams up with chef Alan Bergo to hunt the original poultry — pigeons, and also forages for mushrooms and greens from the Wisconsin landscape.

programme.title: Strangers in Danger 第1季
programme.desc: In this food-filled episode, Catfish throws up all over the world. The biking duo try various forms of genitalia including bull testicle, tiger and sea penis, virgin eggs, otherwise known as pee billed eggs, and more. They try duck head in China and worm tequila and mosquito eggs in Mexico. The question becomes, can you keep it down while watching this special episode.

programme.desc: Catfish and Rooftop go on a mission with the Colombian military's anti-narcotics division, test bulletproof clothing on themselves and experience the most painful insect sting in the world.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.desc: After a morning on the Bayou, the Duck Camp Dinners crew enjoy a fresh cooked dinner while discussing the changing coastal wetlands of Louisiana. Jean-Paul gets to finally a hunt an area he had only heard about as a young man, and takes in the beauty of the live cypress trees this camp is known for.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.desc: After a late night of good times, venison chili, and some old school roux the crew heads out for another day of hunting ducks. Adaptability is critical, and after a couple of quick adjustments the team finds themselves back in the ducks.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation 第2季
programme.desc: When Dick Cabela founded “Cabela’s” in 1961, he was unaware it would become the foremost outfitting store in the world. So it’s only fitting that his son is on a quest to explore the Hard Truths of conservation. Join Dan Cabela, on this high-impact journey of discovery, as he uncovers some lesser-known facts about conservation. In particular, the role which hunting and the utilization of wildlife can play as a modern-day conservation tool.

programme.title: Coral Sea Dreaming 第1季
programme.desc:
Coral Sea Dreaming enters into the very heart of life - and death - on a coral reef. The film follows a story that spans 500 million years and stars some of the most exotic and wondrous marine creatures on earth. Coral is the planets greatest natural architect, and coral reefs boast the highest biodiversity of any ecosystem. 

We meet thousands of reef inhabitants, from ancient turtles to feeding sharks, adorable pygmy seahorses and savage sea slugs, witness a manta ray ballet and courting octopus. 
Specialized state-of-the-art High Definition technology captures these lives with unprecedented intimacy, illustrating elaborate courtship displays, mating rituals, feeding frenzies, intense nighttime predation, cannibalism and chemical warfare. 

Filmed over 2000 dives on coral reef ecosystems; The Great Barrier Reef, Ningaloo Reef, Papua New Guinea and at the Coral Sea; Coral Sea Dreaming is a celebration of reefs now under threat of ocean acidification and climate change. There is much t.

programme.sub-title: You Play With Fire, You Might Get Burned
programme.desc: Tensions mount in Cayuga as a frightening crash occurs on the drag strip moments before Chris is set to perform his incredibly dangerous first night race of the season alongside his still untested Crew Chief, Wayner.

programme.title: Coral Sea Dreaming 第1季
programme.desc:
Coral Sea Dreaming enters into the very heart of life - and death - on a coral reef. The film follows a story that spans 500 million years and stars some of the most exotic and wondrous marine creatures on earth. Coral is the planets greatest natural architect, and coral reefs boast the highest biodiversity of any ecosystem. 

We meet thousands of reef inhabitants, from ancient turtles to feeding sharks, adorable pygmy seahorses and savage sea slugs, witness a manta ray ballet and courting octopus. 
Specialized state-of-the-art High Definition technology captures these lives with unprecedented intimacy, illustrating elaborate courtship displays, mating rituals, feeding frenzies, intense nighttime predation, cannibalism and chemical warfare. 

Filmed over 2000 dives on coral reef ecosystems; The Great Barrier Reef, Ningaloo Reef, Papua New Guinea and at the Coral Sea; Coral Sea Dreaming is a celebration of reefs now under threat of ocean acidification and climate change. There is much t.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.sub-title: Beaux Beauxs at the Hobo Hilton
programme.desc: Whether you call them Pouldeau, American Coot, or Water Chickens, chances are you don’t consider them a delicacy. However, Jean-Paul is out to prove that these abundant birds have a place at the dinner table. Tune in as thew crew makes some incredible gumbo while preparing for their last hunt at Duck Camp.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners 第1季
programme.desc: It's the final day at Duck Camp for Jean-Paul and the guys. They finish up their trip with a morning of hunting followed by an afternoon filled with crawfish and catfish. The trip ends on dry land and the crew reflects on what makes the duck camp so special.

programme.title: Bear's Mission With Warwick Davis 第1季
programme.desc: Legendary actor Warwick Davis is on a Mission with Bear Grylls in the mountains of the Lake District.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: Crouch Recovery Op Jim and heavy mechanic Jack are faced with an increasingly complex recovery challenge. A foreign truck with dodgy suspension airbags and a catalogue of other problems makes towing it anywhere a real headache and a potential threat to other road users. Lantern Recovery op Sean is in a race against time to get a fully loaded dual tanker off a busy stretch of motorway. And recovery op Merrie has a nightmare when an unforeseeable problem leaves her stranded in a live lane of the motorway when towing a car transporter.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: A digger as fallen off the back of a lorry and rolled over on its side - blocking one side of a busy A road. Crouch recovery Incident Manager Steve must work out how to get the vehicle upright without being able to close the whole road – a tricky challenge indeed! Richard Crouch and recovery op Lee Brown have a hay bale of a time trying to get a valuable straw load on a broken-down trailer back safely to its owner. And Crouch recovery op Marta earns her daily bread rescuing a stricken van load of loaves.

PGA巡迴賽: 揮桿為晉級
歡樂家長群
programme.desc: 真相大白，將一切看在眼中的媽媽們都感羞愧，紛紛向曉薇道歉。自此姜飛虎媽媽代替高宇軒媽媽成為新的家委會主任。向上正為自己處理這事的機智果敢得意，但那邊又出事了. . .

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 經過了情感累積，鄭融選擇在2026年重新出發。這段日子，她將時間交還給生活，將經歷留給自己消化，把所有的成長痛楚與領悟，揉合成一種更深厚、更誠實的聲音。今集《港樂．講樂》，鄭融會帶着新作來到現場，與大家一同分享錄音的趣事。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《下不違例.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: Husnain 是土生土長的巴基斯坦裔港人，曾經用一年半時間遊歷68個國家，他自稱是半個旅遊達人。Husnain認為結識朋友不需要在意種族，但他有過因為樣貌而被歧視的經歷，於是他加入開咪講解多元族裔文化，希望可以消除誤解。今集主持Wimmy會和Husnain邊食邊傾.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 今日已復歸和平，亦正重拾昔日光彩─「千丘之國」盧旺達，可謂非洲大陸的精裝本。野生斑馬、大象、長頸鹿在稀樹草原上漫遊，位處山區繁密茂盛的熱帶雨林則為大猩猩及黑猩猩提供庇蔭之地。 不止於美不勝收的自然景致，盧旺達亦擁有豐厚的文化遺產，由民族舞蹈、色彩繽紛的手工藝品，以致於人聲沸騰的墟市均可見一斑。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年9月24日 星期二晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 阿花不擅長保守秘密，因此遭阿菇責備。阿花為了證明自己守秘密的能力，在危急之際，亦拒絕透露守護石的收藏地點。隨著一場螃蟹雨逼近，英雄們必須盡快說服阿花透露她的秘密.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 杜老師在課堂上抽查菲菲背古詩，菲菲又出洋相。小鬱安慰她卻被菲菲遷怒，傷心地跑開。菲菲後悔想道歉，但小鬱失踪。如福幫忙找到了小鬱，菲菲誠心道歉，兩人和好.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 看到莎莎失控出走，一家人終於去找莎莎，沒想到一出門卻被子龍用神力丟進垃圾桶。為求真相眾人回家中，可還沒等搞清狀況幾人又被子龍丟進垃圾桶。眾人設計控制子龍觀看莎莎的記憶，得知莎莎的煩惱，最後在家人們齊心協力下莎莎恢復記憶，一家人也懂得彼此體諒.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第九集：梁富寬打麻將輸光了家中的錢
programme.desc: 林局長來到林場，答應給予更高的下崗補貼，還鼓勵大家轉崗成為護林員。兆喜的眼睛瞎了，可好歹保住了眼球，看上去跟常人無異。梁富寬自從下崗後天天打麻將。，輸光了家中的錢，包括下崗錢。馬曉雲無奈下，找鳳霞借錢還債。馬曉雲挑明讓鳳霞嫁給她大兒子兆成.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 細味風情
programme.desc: 今日已復歸和平，亦正重拾昔日光彩─「千丘之國」盧旺達，可謂非洲大陸的精裝本。野生斑馬、大象、長頸鹿在稀樹草原上漫遊，位處山區繁密茂盛的熱帶雨林則為大猩猩及黑猩猩提供庇蔭之地。 不止於美不勝收的自然景致，盧旺達亦擁有豐厚的文化遺產，由民族舞蹈、色彩繽紛的手工藝品，以致於人聲沸騰的墟市均可見一斑。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年9月24日 星期二晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
唐朝詭事錄
programme.desc: 顏元夫、路公復、冷籍、鍾伯期並稱南州四子，四人聚會情狀被人繪成畫作《石橋圖》，此畫被望賓樓老闆歐陽泉所藏。盧凌風怕影響裴喜君的名聲，想讓她回京，喜君卻不願離去，蘇無名想出與喜君結為義兄妹。路公復七竅流血死亡，盧凌風追查，發現早前攔棺拜師的林寶有嫌疑.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄
programme.desc: 盧凌風審問林寶，林寶招供是因報復殺害路公復。蘇無名帶裴喜君拜訪歐陽泉，欲欣賞《石橋圖》，歐陽泉推說已將畫作出售。二人一走，歐陽泉便帶著《石橋圖》找到收藏家陸離。盧凌風將欲逃出城的陸離抓回，他承認偷了路公復的古琴。蘇無名懸賞追凶，一乞丐來報案.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 小矮人水晶礦洞暫停開採，令森林裡沒有水晶，沒有電力，雪條也在融化！英雄們的任務是找出原因並解決問題。最後發現原來是一隻叫史麥的黏液怪獸把礦場當成自己的家。但由於胡飛非常害怕黏液，要驅趕黏黏的史麥也不容易.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 院子裡的地瓜乾消失了，為了找出偷吃賊，如福們守株待兔，發現地窖後隱藏的大空間，找到偷吃的地鼠阿疤和阿豁。夏美利用與動物溝通的能力，得知牠們在儲存冬糧.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君為了奪取子軒子涵的關注，撒謊告訴他們小鎮外的稻田有一隻神秘田螺怪，卻不料引起子軒子涵好奇，兩人相約朋友去稻田探險。為了不露餡，灶君開始阻擋小朋友探險的腳步，卻反而促使他們早早到達探險地，沒想到稻田裡真的有田螺怪.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第三十九集：果寶幾人在學校春遊中迷路
programme.desc: 學校舉辦春遊活動，糖豆、果寶、姜飛虎幾人一起偷偷溜出了班級隊伍，肖家瑞偷偷跟了上去。幾個孩子跑了很久也沒找到小樹苗，想原路返回，卻發現自己迷路了，隨身攜帶的地圖和指南針派不上用場，電話手錶也沒有信號.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 親愛的 請別忘記我
programme.desc: 當親人患了認知症，家人如何為他們備份記憶、如何與他們交流情感？除了藥物治療和基本照料，親人在認知症照護中還能做些甚麼？本集講述了自由插畫師亦鄰和其認知症母親一起繪畫、回憶過去，努力延緩記憶衰退的故事.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.sub-title: 第十九集 港海覓魚
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了BLOOM Association Hong Kong國際海洋保育及研究員佘國豪和海洋項目經理何嘉欣，分享有關香港珊瑚魚類的知識。本集以黑尾蝶、蘇眉及白斑躄魚作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索珊瑚魚的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生存智慧。. #大自然逐樣解#港海覓魚#珊瑚魚#黑尾蝶#蘇眉#白斑躄魚#海洋保育.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第十集：陳興傑成了全市狀元
programme.desc: 興傑成了全市狀元，而曉晴的成績差強人意，林恒勸女兒複讀，曉晴想參考興傑的意見去廣深讀大學。鄉親們來給興傑上學送紅包，存花想不要，可抵不過大家的熱情。興傑離開時，存花準備了六千塊錢，興傑感動不已。鳳霞在夜總會賣啤酒被打後，準備和大兒子兆成結婚.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
唐朝詭事錄
programme.desc: 恰逢南州鄉賢謝公的兩位公子考上進士，謝公在湖心島大宴賓客，謝家公子乘舟前往湖心島，兩位公子及船公之後死亡。裴喜君發現，他們三人都出現在《石橋圖》中。蘇無名驚覺，《石橋圖》中出現的人都先後遭遇了不測。蘇無名力排眾議，對顏元夫開棺驗屍，發現一顆蟲皮.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄
programme.sub-title: 第十三集: 石橋圖 (5) / 甘棠驛怪談 (4)
programme.desc: 蘇無名與費雞師到藥鋪調查，蟲名叫墨瘋子，專鑽人的七竅。鍾伯期欲與冷籍重遊石橋，蘇無名等人一起前往。中途，鍾伯期劇烈咳嗽，自稱身患絕症。費雞師診斷後告知此病可醫。至此，蘇無名已經掌握了線索。石橋圖案已結，蘇無名惦念起甘棠驛一案，決定再探甘棠驛.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 菲斯的行為非常奇怪，他拒絕在小妮的文件上蓋印，個性亦變得隨和可親！英雄們感到懷疑，並肯定有人把他和其他人的身份交換了。英雄們必須找出真正的菲斯，並在森林變成一片混亂前救他回來.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 朝風挑戰菲菲，如福們為菲菲展開魔鬼訓練。挑戰日，菲菲出其不意地智取，未選擇硬碰硬.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 子軒子涵之間再次爆發兄妹矛盾，子軒散發出來的負能量吸引了小衰神。一個利用讓激發人們產生更多負能量的睚眥怪，附著在人體上，以達到破壞趙家、一切照計劃進行，小鎮充滿各種爭吵，危機時刻灶君堅守本心，利用神環將睚眥怪一網打盡，小衰神只得敗興而歸.

programme.title: 歡樂家長群
programme.sub-title: 第四十集：唐曉薇和糖豆要搬回天津
programme.desc: 馬英杰求婚成功，但由於母親身體欠佳，糖豆母子二人不得不從北京到天津兩地往返。唐曉薇決定要帶着糖豆搬回天津。果寶因捨不得糖豆離開而生氣大鬧.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 米是中國人稻作文明的璀璨明珠，在古老而廣袤的中華大地上，禾苗破土而出，汲取自然的精華，醞釀出一顆顆飽滿的稻粒，成為我們餐桌上的重要主糧。在早餐餐桌上，米變換著各種形態，飯團、粽子、白粥、米皮，平凡的米成就了精彩的味道。. 美食介紹:烏飯團，蝦酥，小卷筒.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 在充滿市井欣悅的清晨煙火中，有一種由微生物和時間共同作用的「魔法」，經由先輩們千年的智慧，以一種神秘的方式在中國人的早餐桌上佔據了重要地位，它便是我們耳熟能詳的古老製作工藝——發酵。. 美食介紹:梅仙肉光餅，醪糟，海兔醬.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第十集：陳興傑成了全市狀元
programme.desc: 興傑成了全市狀元，而曉晴的成績差強人意，林恒勸女兒複讀，曉晴想參考興傑的意見去廣深讀大學。鄉親們來給興傑上學送紅包，存花想不要，可抵不過大家的熱情。興傑離開時，存花準備了六千塊錢，興傑感動不已。鳳霞在夜總會賣啤酒被打後，準備和大兒子兆成結婚.

programme.title: 童真無國界
programme.desc: This is a story about a child named Basir. One day, Basir’s mother and father had an argument, causing Basir’s father to leave. Basir’s father gave 2 fishing rods to Basir before leaving his family. . Basir then used the rods to fish with his friend Hamani. While they were playing, Basir ran into 2 girls in the forest. They were looking for a beautiful location to paint. Then Basir took them to a beautiful lake location. On the way to the lake, Hamani felt that he was ostracised because Basir was busy entertaining his new friend Eshal, Hamani then boarded the boat on the lakeside and left Basir.

programme.title: 《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.sub-title: Episode 3 “Physical Science Prize – Topological Electronic Materials”
programme.desc: Successful scientific research results often arise from collaboration between scientists from multiple disciplines. The award-winning study for the Future Science Prize in Physical Science this year – the computational prediction and experimental realisation of topological electronic materials – is a distinctive example of collaboration between three scientists, namely Professor Zhong FANG, Professor Xi DAI and Professor Hong DING. . Professor Zhong FANG and Professor Xi DAI discovered that the “electronic band structure” of certain materials would generate an extremely stable conductivity state and resist impurities interference. On the other hand, Professor Hong DING, by using the “angle resolved photoemission spectroscopy” technology, detected the existence of “Weyl semimetal” in the laboratory for the first time. . Their collaboration demonstrates the complementarity of theoretical prediction and experimental authentication. It not only transforms the once abstract scientific theories into materials that can be applied practically, but also shows the importance of interdisciplinary collaboration.

programme.title: 香港故事：邊境人家
programme.sub-title: Nam Chung: LOHAS around the border
programme.desc: Straight roads, rolling hills, and tranquil fishponds define Nam Chung, a 300-year-old Hakka village south of Sha Tau Kok. Home to five clans, it is led by young village head Chan Sai-leong, who carries his father’s legacy by overseeing an eight-year restoration of the Nam Chung Hip Tin Temple. This sacred space now serves as a hub for worship, arbitration, and community bonding. Former university professor Chan Shun-hing, a decade-long advocate for Nam Chung’s ecological revival, relocated to live sustainably with the Reed Blossom Eco-Education Fund. Through seven years of oral history, she weaves herself into the community. In this verdant haven, each resident builds their own paradise.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 突然有網媒對因公殉職的張婉茹詆毀污蔑，其弟弟張小北也失聯。安旎懷疑網媒的背後並不簡單，時間太過巧合。深夜，張小北狼狽地出現在了安旎的門口，原來，張小北是被綁架逃回來的。張小北跟安旎和何陸源舉報了惠權遊戲有問題的情況，並具體描述了自己的懷疑.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 韓軒根據張小北提供的線索，篩查惠權遊戲的充值機制，發現背後有一組演算法，精准地鎖定目標並發送非法網貸的廣告。新的證據再次指向了723案件背後仍有黑手，安旎向郭洪江彙報了自己曾對錢天心案件原有疑慮的指向。何陸源率隊正式搜查惠權，趙冀凱做好了最壞的打算.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 守護天堂
programme.sub-title: 泰國翁龐野生動物保護區
programme.desc: 翁龐野生動物保護區是泰國最大的保護區，也是亞洲重要的生物多樣性庇護所及聯合國教科文組織的世界遺產。其高海拔的雨林孕育了多樣化的野生動物及鳥類。區內密集的河流網絡及泰國最大的瀑布，在當地為期六個月的乾季，對維持生態系統的健康至關重要，亦為各種動物提供了全年所需的食物。. 然而，盜獵、人類開發、農業擴張及棕櫚樹種植園的設立對保護區構成重大威脅。透過巡邏人員巡查遏制盜獵和收集保育數據、科學家研究人類活動的影響從而制定出有效的保護策略，以及新一代關注生態的泰國人加入保育行列，正為保護這片自然寶藏帶來希望。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年6月24日 星期二 晚上10時. . Umphang Sanctuary, Thailand’s largest protected area, is a vital biodiversity refuge in Asia and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its high-altitude rainforest supports a diverse array of wildlife and bird species. The sanctuary's dense river network and its largest waterfalls play a crucial role in sustaining this ecosystem during the six-month dry season, providing year-round food for various animal populations. . However, the sanctuary faces significant threats from poaching, human development, agricultural expansion, and the establishment of oil palm plantations. Rangers patrol the area to combat poaching and collect conservation data, while scientists study human impacts to develop effective protection strategies. A new generation of environmentally conscious Thais also offers hope for the preservation of this natural treasure. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.06.24 Tue 10pm.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳
programme.desc: 在香港的傳統文化地圖上，有一個鮮為人知的故事——客家貔貅。資深傳承人鍾浩聲師傅，三十年來將南鷹爪門白鶴派的精髓融入貔貅表演之中。成立香港獅藝舘龍獅體育會，致力推廣客家傳統文化。其兒子亦當上第七代傳人，在爸爸薰陶下成長，漸漸愛上這門藝術。父子兩代人，穿梭於香港與內地之間，把這份三百年客家傳統延續下去，見證香港文化傳承的生命力.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳
programme.desc: 舞火龍源自漢代的傳統儀式，在香港大坑和薄扶林村得以延續。蕭昆崙這位薄扶林村的火龍守護者，用雙手將竹篾與香火編織成威武的火龍，延續著這門源自漢代的古老傳統。六十年來，他對舞火龍的熱愛從未減退，不斷精進紥龍技藝。而今，他的兒子蕭震南承襲父親的熱情，父子倆攜手開辦工作坊，傳授製作迷你火龍的技巧。在他們的努力下，薄扶林村的舞火龍傳統煥發新生，在現代社會繼續延燒著傳統文化的火種.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 經過了情感累積，鄭融選擇在2026年重新出發。這段日子，她將時間交還給生活，將經歷留給自己消化，把所有的成長痛楚與領悟，揉合成一種更深厚、更誠實的聲音。今集《港樂．講樂》，鄭融會帶着新作來到現場，與大家一同分享錄音的趣事。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《下不違例.

周末大電影 : 烈火戰車
programme.desc: 年幼喪母的 Joe(劉德華飾)缺乏自信心,唯有一面在非法電單車賽中獲勝作為短暫心理慰藉,一面又挑戰父親(秦沛飾)旗下車手來向父宣洩不滿。他打算參加公開賽,卻苦無贊助商,因商戶害怕開罪他父親,父子關係因而惡化。Joe 偶然認識了外地回港的車手關大衛(吳大維飾),二人亦友亦敵。Joe 多年同居女友阿儀(梁詠琪飾)一直極力反對 Joe 賽車,二人經常為此吵架.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集專注於男性之間的「情感連結」。男性友誼在歷史長河中曾是社會穩定的基石，也是藝術與文學最愛歌頌的題材。我們將探討這種特殊的關係形態，如何在現代社會中悄然質變。而當代文化又如何重新詮釋男性友誼？「Bromance」一詞的出現，反映了社會對男性友情的何種新認知？. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 曾奕文(音樂學院副教授). 蕭欣浩(大學講師). 雷有輝(歌手). #兄弟Band #兄弟情#太極樂隊#雷有輝#學人沙龍.

programme.title: 棋士
programme.sub-title: 第九集：崔偉巧用電台引劫匪
programme.desc: 多年前夏爸被騙光家產，吃飯時在肉裏下毒想帶兩個兒子自殺，哥哥察覺掀桌拉夏生逃走，承諾把錢賺回來。如今崔業給張校長錢辦大師班，請陳主任出席，又帶淑華去西餐廳吃最貴牛排，坦白崔炎高病情，要她決定離婚或一起去香港治病，回家便讓秋萍拿出雙人被說淑華要回來。崔偉推斷第五劫匪是夏生親兄弟，血液證實後想出釣夏生的辦法。夏生帶夏雨坐快艇出海，改述往事並說要回老家可能不再回來，留下給賭徒夏海濤的禮物。崔偉上FM97.4直播談劫匪遺體若無人認領將成孤魂野鬼，夏生鐵青臉忍住沒打電話，趙副局長卻冒充觀眾攪局。最後夏生到殯儀館給哥哥燒紙，小丁注意到風吹起的火星.

programme.title: 夢想中華人物誌
programme.desc: 一代華學大師饒宗頤教授，長於治學與鑽研，在國學、文史、考古及藝術創作等二十五門學科中，皆展現卓越才華。他由故鄉潮州起步，在動盪時代中守望文化；移居香港後，更善用中西交匯的優勢，搜羅全球文獻遺珍，在國際學壇寫下輝煌篇章。. 饒公不僅在學術上開創新局，更親身實踐「學藝雙攜」，將鑽研梵文與敦煌經卷等多個學科的深厚學養，熔鑄於個人書畫神韻之中。他深信「二十一世紀是中國文藝復興的時代」，並將這份信念化為行動，於晚年積極推動跨地域學術交流，悉心提攜後輩。其影響力遍及全球，為後世留下了豐厚且生生不息的文化遺產。. 受訪者包括：. 李焯芬教授（香港大學饒宗頤學術館館長、饒宗頤文化館管理委員會主席）. 姚錫安博士（香港大學饒宗頤學術館副館長）. 曾憲通教授（中山大學中文系教授）. 鄭會欣教授（香港中文大學中國文化研究所名譽高級研究員）. 王奮（潮州饒宗頤博物館文博館員.

programme.sub-title: 泰國翁龐野生動物保護區
programme.desc: 翁龐野生動物保護區是泰國最大的保護區，也是亞洲重要的生物多樣性庇護所及聯合國教科文組織的世界遺產。其高海拔的雨林孕育了多樣化的野生動物及鳥類。區內密集的河流網絡及泰國最大的瀑布，在當地為期六個月的乾季，對維持生態系統的健康至關重要，亦為各種動物提供了全年所需的食物。. 然而，盜獵、人類開發、農業擴張及棕櫚樹種植園的設立對保護區構成重大威脅。透過巡邏人員巡查遏制盜獵和收集保育數據、科學家研究人類活動的影響從而制定出有效的保護策略，以及新一代關注生態的泰國人加入保育行列，正為保護這片自然寶藏帶來希望。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2025年6月24日 星期二 晚上10時. . Umphang Sanctuary, Thailand’s largest protected area, is a vital biodiversity refuge in Asia and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Its high-altitude rainforest supports a diverse array of wildlife and bird species. The sanctuary's dense river network and its largest waterfalls play a crucial role in sustaining this ecosystem during the six-month dry season, providing year-round food for various animal populations. . However, the sanctuary faces significant threats from poaching, human development, agricultural expansion, and the establishment of oil palm plantations. Rangers patrol the area to combat poaching and collect conservation data, while scientists study human impacts to develop effective protection strategies. A new generation of environmentally conscious Thais also offers hope for the preservation of this natural treasure. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version & Web version) . Time: (First run) 2025.06.24 Tue 10pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 航拍海岸線 (第一季)
programme.desc: 中山，作為廣東省內一顆璀璨的明珠，不僅以其深厚的歷史文化底蘊聞名，更以其現代化的城市面貌和活力四射的生活節奏吸引着人們的目光。從五桂山的蔥郁山林到古勞水鄉的蜿蜒水道，從客家土樓的歷史沉澱到孫中山故居的莊嚴肅穆，每一處都展現了中山市獨有的魅力.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 航拍海岸線 (第一季)
programme.desc: 汕頭，廣東東部的明珠，以其得天獨厚的地理位置和豐富的海洋資源著稱，更以其深厚的潮汕文化和歷史傳承吸引着世界的目光。汕頭的老城區，以其獨特的騎樓建築和歷史悠久的街道，訴說著這座城市的過往與變遷。汕頭的現代城市面貌，高樓林立，交通發達，展現了這座城市在新時代的發展與進步.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 接送放學、陪玩、換片、餵奶，現今爸爸不再只是搵錢養家，更要學做「湊仔公」。隨着雙職家庭普及、女性經濟能力提升，傳統「男主外、女主內」的分工逐漸改變。然而爸爸們手上並無「育兒說明書」，有人靠回憶原生父親的教養方式，有人更主動讀陪月課程，希望做到「神隊友」爸爸。 本集將走訪幾位「湊仔公」，記錄他們在跌撞中學習的真實故事，探討現代爸爸如何重新定義父親這個角色.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師帶大家回到瑪雅文明時代，當時的瑪雅人喜歡喝一種由可可豆製成的飲品Xocoatl。後來的人更利用可可豆，製成一種易於運送及儲存的食品---「朱古力」，而朱古力更成為全球最受歡迎的甜品之一。然而，尋古大師在周遊列國的旅程中，竟然連一口朱古力都很難嚐到.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師帶我們回到古代的中國，我們在那裡發現了足球的前身——「蹴鞠」的起源。當時「蹴鞠」以羽毛作為內部物料；時至今日，足球生產不斷改良，更成為實驗室研究的產品。尋古大師更上場向我們展示足球是如何演變成全球受歡迎的運動.

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師原本約定要與賽思見面，但他發現單車的輪胎洩了氣，此時他必須尋找其他方法，才能趕及赴約。德萊斯男爵借了一輛滑動車給他–這正是現代單車的始祖。大師試過多款不同滑動車後，最後騎上一輛電動單車與朋友會合。這會否就是單車的未來.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 小鎮正舉辦人氣之星的大賽，獲讚最多就是小鎮人氣之星。子涵在灶君的幫助下，得到了一張萬人追捧符，果然子涵人氣飆升，正當子涵以為人氣全部歸功於神器，卻發現剛剛忙中出錯，拿到的只是一張普通的促銷標籤，自己的人氣是憑自己的實力獲得，是小鎮真正的人氣之星.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 子軒無意中看到下棋的灶君，利用神環放慢時間作弊，作為要挾子軒明白了神環可以加速減速。子軒趁機奪走神環並給灶君減速，得到神環的子軒開始利用神環玩遊戲作弊，沒想到神環使用過度，子軒停不下來，而灶君則慢得過分.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 顧拜為了避開小杜的監視，困住了他，小杜失控衝出教室。菲菲召集如福侍衛隊去找小杜，卻發現維修中心關門了。雖然小杜未能修好，但兩人認清了在課堂上打鬧的錯誤.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 大桔送作業本到學校，卻被杜老師誤以為是玩具，鎖在儲物櫃裡。菲菲召喚如福解救大桔，但幾次嘗試後，大桔被杜老師塞進紙箱，鎖在櫃子裡，準備學期結束後再還給菲菲.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In a rapidly aging society like Hong Kong, late-life romance and marriage may bring positive impacts if handled appropriately. Could such relationships enhance seniors’ mental well-being? What role can the government and voluntary organizations play in supporting elders who wish to remarry? What benefits might it bring to their emotional health.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 中華飲食文化周暨學生廚藝大賽
programme.desc: 活動由香港直接資助學校議會及何東中學合辦，透過中華飲食文化周活動，讓學生了解中華飲食文化精髓，並學習當中的歷史與文化內涵，從而培養他們研習中國文化的興趣與能力。大會更進一步舉行學生廚藝大賽，以家鄉菜式為主題，讓學生透過烹飪，認識自己的籍貫及加深對家鄉的感情.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 老店情未了第二季 (英文版)
programme.desc: Known as the “four great inventions of the dining table”, congee, rice noodles, egg noodles, and rice are mainstays in our daily diet. Much of the noodles served in our local eateries are supplied by noodle makers. . In this day and age, there are fewer and fewer factories in Hong Kong that make both rice and egg noodles – one of them is a time-honoured brand located in Fanling. Its artisans work tirelessly through the night, rain or shine, to ensure that major restaurant groups have a stable supply all year round. They can be regarded as the unsung heroes of the food and beverage industry. . What does the third-generation owner think of the age-old brand? Has he inherited a business, a way of life, or a mindset? Let’s discover the human touch behind this family-run factory.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 安旎向723專案組彙報了驗證過後的惠權遊戲裏面的問題。警方連夜提審了尹惠權和趙冀凱，趙冀凱將自己的責任推卸的一乾二淨，而透過“玻璃”監控着審訊的安旎和何陸源配合默契地提出了數個“刁鑽”的問題，而趙冀凱放佛早有準備般將所有嫌疑都推給了尹惠權.

programme.title: 公訴
programme.desc: 趙冀凱違背對李儀棠的諾言，主動找到安旎自首，承認了所有在惠權集團的問題都是自己所為。趙冀凱被轉交警方，被正式審訊。崩潰的李儀棠找到安旎追問趙冀凱的情況，李儀棠不滿安旎追擊趙冀凱，兩姐妹感情決裂.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 中華飲食文化周暨學生廚藝大賽
programme.desc: 活動由香港直接資助學校議會及何東中學合辦，透過中華飲食文化周活動，讓學生了解中華飲食文化精髓，並學習當中的歷史與文化內涵，從而培養他們研習中國文化的興趣與能力。大會更進一步舉行學生廚藝大賽，以家鄉菜式為主題，讓學生透過烹飪，認識自己的籍貫及加深對家鄉的感情.

programme.title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.sub-title: 全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮 : 短劇製作特輯-熱血東江 薪火相傳
programme.desc: 「全民國家安全教育日開幕典禮暨主題講座」，由香港特別行政區維護國家安全委員會(國安委)主辦。香港電台除了負責直播之外，亦就當中的青少年短劇表演製作特輯。. 同學隨參訪團參觀內地及香港與抗戰相關的地點，深入了解到先輩在抗日戰爭中所展現的偉大抗戰精神，並將體會融入短劇演出中，呈現中國共產黨領導的東江縱隊在抗日戰爭中的英勇事跡，表達對國家安全的理解及愛國情懷。節目旨在提升市民的國家安全意識，並以深入淺出的方式讓市民明白國家安全的重要性、全面性，以及國家安全與全港每一位市民的密切關係.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：世界交響樂音樂會
programme.desc: 世界交響樂音樂會展現香港多元的音樂文化，在指揮麥家樂帶領下，寰宇交響樂團為觀眾呈獻跨世代的音樂華章，鋼琴家黃家舜、小提琴手廖姵珳聯同女高音林舒婷，以精湛技藝演繹經典交響名作，感受音樂的永恆魅力。音樂會片段由寰宇交響樂團提供。. 表演曲目:. 莫扎特《長笛與豎琴協奏曲》（第二樂章）. 柴可夫斯基《一個可愛的地方的回憶》. 蕭斯達高維契《第二圓舞曲》. 拉赫曼尼諾夫《帕格尼尼主題狂想曲》第十八變奏. 鮑羅定《韃靼人之舞》. 約翰·威廉斯《舒特拉的名單》主題曲. 比才《卡門》的《哈巴涅拉》. 比才第一《卡門》組曲：鬥牛士進行曲.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台: 孔子傳
programme.desc: 古代教育家孔子的故事家喻戶曉，他一生跌宕起伏，閱歷豐富，弟子眾多，更留下深刻的睿智。《孔子傳》突出孔子為人師表的一面，通過他對弟子的教誨，以及求教於前輩老子等片段，帶出孔子的人生哲學。. 由男中音林俊廷飾演孔子，聲樂教授阮妙芬飾演南子(衛靈公夫人)，男高音林俊傑飾演老子，男低音林國浩飾演子路。此外，符潤光帶領的香港歌劇社合唱團參與演出。. 麥家樂(作曲、指揮及歌劇導演). 旅歐逾30年的作曲家兼指揮家，曾於2000榮獲俄羅斯文化獎，2018年成為首位華人獲得世界級「奧地利音樂劇院獎」.

programme.title: 守藝薪傳
programme.desc: 長衫，見證中國服飾文化變遷。由清朝到上世紀二十年代的上海風潮，帶起南來香港裁縫師傅的手藝，於香港生根發芽。周師傅，自十六歲跟爸爸學師，入行三十四年，延續傳統長衫製作的精細技藝，手上一針一線可見幾十年功夫累積的心血。原學西裁的徒弟Katrina，被這門細緻講究的手藝深深吸引，投入研究與保育工作，以現代的眼光推廣與傳承，令長衫的美學融入生活日常，望帶起長衫風朝的另一章.

programme.title: 口述澳門歷史名人堂
programme.desc: 高劍父，1879年出生於廣東， 1938年廣州淪陷後輾轉到澳門，居住在普濟禪院妙香堂，開辦春睡畫院。他提倡藝術革命，以「折衷中西，融匯古今」為宗旨，與高奇峰、陳樹人一同創立嶺南畫派。他桃李滿門，並多次舉行師生畫展，為難童籌備經費，他在1951病逝於鏡湖醫院.

programme.title: 口述澳門歷史名人堂
programme.desc: 冼星海，1905年出生於澳門一個漁民家庭。他在小城度過童年，孕育他至誠至善的品格。他筆下震古爍今的不朽巨作《黃河大合唱》為中國音樂史寫下光輝一頁，是每個中國人心中的「人民音樂家」.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 經過了情感累積，鄭融選擇在2026年重新出發。這段日子，她將時間交還給生活，將經歷留給自己消化，把所有的成長痛楚與領悟，揉合成一種更深厚、更誠實的聲音。今集《港樂．講樂》，鄭融會帶着《13樓的大笨象》來到現場，與大家一同揭開這幾年間的內心獨白，分享她在生活沉澱後的蛻變。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《13樓的大笨象.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 富爸爸岑幸富因交通意外失去左手，照顧兩個女時，往往要靠太太協助，但他都盡力去做。天生不良於行的前輪椅劍擊運動員梁志光是三個年幼子女的父親，身體障別並沒有阻礙他們成為一個稱職的爸爸，兩位爸爸都十分愛錫子女，亦各有育兒理念，今個父親節，他們會交流一下.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
棋士
programme.sub-title: 第十集：崔業向電台檢舉大哥
programme.desc: 夏生父親在空蕩工廠上吊自盡，小丁只剩一地燒焦黃紙。張校長辦好大師班會所，崔業視察時接夏生電話，趕去見他。夏生請崔業帶回哥哥骨灰，崔業說是警察詭計，夏生堅持只能託他。崔業裝白灰渣當骨灰交給夏生，夏生聞父死訊崩潰哭到嘔吐，抱假骨灰對哥哥說話，崔業不忍揭穿，夏生憤而把灰渣揚崔業滿臉並揮拳。崔業告訴他哥哥是替他死的，勸他帶錢回老家重新開始。崔業回家問兒子邱琳入學事，含冰塊偽裝聲音舉報崔偉濫用職權。崔偉查菸酒標識溯源鄲通，找到東風煤礦，卻被趙副局長通知因舉報停職。崔業迎回提行李的淑華，淑華回家下廚，炎高興奮秀新魚缸，淑華放魚食時發現櫃子隔間藏滿整齊人民幣。崔業去崔偉家告知炎高病情並安慰他。最後大師班開幕，張校長請陳主任出席，崔業上台講話，崔偉一家姍姍來遲遞銀行卡被拒，全家拍了全家福，同時夏生坐上回家的火車.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
FIDE世界團體快棋超快棋國際象棋錦標賽2026
香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 一場體育賽事的可觀性，不僅依賴運動員精彩的表現，還有一種看不見卻無處不在的元素——體育展示團隊的聲音。. 擔任體育展示主持近十年的鄭嘉寶（Mabel），在場邊以聲音帶動氣氛，牽引觀眾情緒。然而，真正關鍵的，並不只是聲音本身，而是選擇——何時開口、說甚麼，往往在一瞬之間，決定了氣氛如何被推進，一步步為體育賽事展示出如舞台表演般的現場體驗。. 體育場外，Mable將這份經驗帶入校園。透過學生參與校內比賽及學界賽事的體育展示工作，呈現他們由猶豫到嘗試、由觀察到出聲的過程。. 在她的引導下，體育展示不再只是帶動氣氛，更成為一種教學與實踐。學生在一次次嘗試之中，於無壓力的環境建立自信，在觀察與猶豫之間，找到屬於自己的發聲的時機.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 接送放學、陪玩、換片、餵奶，現今爸爸不再只是搵錢養家，更要學做「湊仔公」。隨着雙職家庭普及、女性經濟能力提升，傳統「男主外、女主內」的分工逐漸改變。然而爸爸們手上並無「育兒說明書」，有人靠回憶原生父親的教養方式，有人更主動讀陪月課程，希望做到「神隊友」爸爸。 本集將走訪幾位「湊仔公」，記錄他們在跌撞中學習的真實故事，探討現代爸爸如何重新定義父親這個角色.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 經過了情感累積，鄭融選擇在2026年重新出發。這段日子，她將時間交還給生活，將經歷留給自己消化，把所有的成長痛楚與領悟，揉合成一種更深厚、更誠實的聲音。今集《港樂．講樂》，鄭融會帶着《13樓的大笨象》來到現場，與大家一同揭開這幾年間的內心獨白，分享她在生活沉澱後的蛻變。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《13樓的大笨象.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 富爸爸岑幸富因交通意外失去左手，照顧兩個女時，往往要靠太太協助，但他都盡力去做。天生不良於行的前輪椅劍擊運動員梁志光是三個年幼子女的父親，身體障別並沒有阻礙他們成為一個稱職的爸爸，兩位爸爸都十分愛錫子女，亦各有育兒理念，今個父親節，他們會交流一下.

programme.title: 棋士
programme.sub-title: 第十集：崔業向電台檢舉大哥
programme.desc: 夏生父親在空蕩工廠上吊自盡，小丁只剩一地燒焦黃紙。張校長辦好大師班會所，崔業視察時接夏生電話，趕去見他。夏生請崔業帶回哥哥骨灰，崔業說是警察詭計，夏生堅持只能託他。崔業裝白灰渣當骨灰交給夏生，夏生聞父死訊崩潰哭到嘔吐，抱假骨灰對哥哥說話，崔業不忍揭穿，夏生憤而把灰渣揚崔業滿臉並揮拳。崔業告訴他哥哥是替他死的，勸他帶錢回老家重新開始。崔業回家問兒子邱琳入學事，含冰塊偽裝聲音舉報崔偉濫用職權。崔偉查菸酒標識溯源鄲通，找到東風煤礦，卻被趙副局長通知因舉報停職。崔業迎回提行李的淑華，淑華回家下廚，炎高興奮秀新魚缸，淑華放魚食時發現櫃子隔間藏滿整齊人民幣。崔業去崔偉家告知炎高病情並安慰他。最後大師班開幕，張校長請陳主任出席，崔業上台講話，崔偉一家姍姍來遲遞銀行卡被拒，全家拍了全家福，同時夏生坐上回家的火車.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: In a rapidly aging society like Hong Kong, late-life romance and marriage may bring positive impacts if handled appropriately. Could such relationships enhance seniors’ mental well-being? What role can the government and voluntary organizations play in supporting elders who wish to remarry? What benefits might it bring to their emotional health.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 老店情未了第二季 (英文版)
programme.desc: Known as the “four great inventions of the dining table”, congee, rice noodles, egg noodles, and rice are mainstays in our daily diet. Much of the noodles served in our local eateries are supplied by noodle makers. . In this day and age, there are fewer and fewer factories in Hong Kong that make both rice and egg noodles – one of them is a time-honoured brand located in Fanling. Its artisans work tirelessly through the night, rain or shine, to ensure that major restaurant groups have a stable supply all year round. They can be regarded as the unsung heroes of the food and beverage industry. . What does the third-generation owner think of the age-old brand? Has he inherited a business, a way of life, or a mindset? Let’s discover the human touch behind this family-run factory.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 肺癌是本港頭號致命癌症，而肺腺癌則是其中一種最常見的肺癌。肺腺癌在早期往往沒有明顯症狀，容易被忽視，不少患者確診時已屬中晚期，常被形容為「無聲殺手」。即使是非吸煙人士，也有機會患上肺腺癌，尤其在亞洲女性當中更為常見。. 及早發現肺癌能提升治癒率，本集請來臨床腫瘤科專科醫生講解肺腺癌的成因、症狀，以及治療方法。. 主持:鄭萃雯、羅英勤醫生. 嘉賓:唐美思醫生(臨床腫瘤科專科醫生).

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 一場體育賽事的可觀性，不僅依賴運動員精彩的表現，還有一種看不見卻無處不在的元素——體育展示團隊的聲音。. 擔任體育展示主持近十年的鄭嘉寶（Mabel），在場邊以聲音帶動氣氛，牽引觀眾情緒。然而，真正關鍵的，並不只是聲音本身，而是選擇——何時開口、說甚麼，往往在一瞬之間，決定了氣氛如何被推進，一步步為體育賽事展示出如舞台表演般的現場體驗。. 體育場外，Mable將這份經驗帶入校園。透過學生參與校內比賽及學界賽事的體育展示工作，呈現他們由猶豫到嘗試、由觀察到出聲的過程。. 在她的引導下，體育展示不再只是帶動氣氛，更成為一種教學與實踐。學生在一次次嘗試之中，於無壓力的環境建立自信，在觀察與猶豫之間，找到屬於自己的發聲的時機.

programme.title: 父輩的榮耀
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：梁鳳霞和顧兆成結婚
programme.desc: 鳳霞和兆成決定去縣城拍結婚照，出發前回家給爺爺宋留喜和雙方父母敬酒，鳳霞表現勉強。新婚夜裏，兩人合衣而眠。學校裏，興傑終於鼓起勇氣跟曉晴表白。下崗的工人們奮力地在生活的逆境中掙扎。到了2007年的春天，兆喜和自強替大梁子收木耳。興傑和曉晴準備結婚.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 米是中國人稻作文明的璀璨明珠，在古老而廣袤的中華大地上，禾苗破土而出，汲取自然的精華，醞釀出一顆顆飽滿的稻粒，成為我們餐桌上的重要主糧。在早餐餐桌上，米變換著各種形態，飯團、粽子、白粥、米皮，平凡的米成就了精彩的味道。. 美食介紹:烏飯團，蝦酥，小卷筒.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 早安早餐: 晨曦裏的煙火中國
programme.desc: 在充滿市井欣悅的清晨煙火中，有一種由微生物和時間共同作用的「魔法」，經由先輩們千年的智慧，以一種神秘的方式在中國人的早餐桌上佔據了重要地位，它便是我們耳熟能詳的古老製作工藝——發酵。. 美食介紹:梅仙肉光餅，醪糟，海兔醬.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
唐朝詭事錄
programme.sub-title: 第十四集: 甘棠驛怪談 (5) / 黃梅殺 (1)
programme.desc: 盧凌風與蘇無名喬裝前往甘棠驛，開門之人竟是被捕的劉十八。是夜，裝睡的蘇無名二人被劉十八和紅衣怪人運進了地窖，窖內竟然有三胞胎兄弟…黃梅雨天，文廟內舉人獨孤遐叔窺見妻子輕紅與同窗劉有求偷歡。獨孤遐叔冒雨返回家中，見妻子在家。夢中他將輕紅和劉有求殺死.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄
programme.desc: 劉有求真的死了，蘇無名提審獨孤遐叔，獨孤遐叔言辭閃爍，蘇無名欲擒故縱，暗中派人觀察。盧凌風奔赴輕紅家，發現輕紅並未回家，沿途山賊橫行，輕紅恐遭不測。裴喜君與薛環扮成趕路姐妹，引出山賊。山賊頭目欲對二人不軌。盧凌風帶兵闖入山賊窩.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 經過了情感累積，鄭融選擇在2026年重新出發。這段日子，她將時間交還給生活，將經歷留給自己消化，把所有的成長痛楚與領悟，揉合成一種更深厚、更誠實的聲音。今集《港樂．講樂》，鄭融會帶着《13樓的大笨象》來到現場，與大家一同揭開這幾年間的內心獨白，分享她在生活沉澱後的蛻變。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《13樓的大笨象.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 菲斯收拾行裝準備去滑雪，郤被一條龍叼走了他的黃金抓毛背心，他需要英雄們奪回黃金抓毛背心。菲斯的侄女彩姿跟隨他們一起做任務，但她的笨拙郤幾乎令整個行動失敗.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 為了防止柿子砸傷行人，胡同街口被路障擋住。如福們決定摘掉柿子，但遭到喜鵲攻擊，原來喜鵲在保護鳥窩.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 古董大盜再次歸來，可家裡只有灶君和子涵在，電話線被惡意剪斷、家門眼看也要失守。為了拖延時等待警察救援，灶君和子涵和古董大盜展開了一場智力角逐，最終有驚無險地躲過追擊，再次將古董大盜抓捕歸案.

programme.title: 老家伙
programme.sub-title: 第一集：三人建立養老中心
programme.desc: 退休新城集團員工肖長慶、孫前程和和前新城集團董事長陳新城，他們來到一個老廠區，破敗景象撲面而來，肖長慶和陳新城頓覺被騙。相反，孫前程卻自信滿滿，稱只要拿到這塊地皮的養老用地批文，招商引資工作就可以立馬進行.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 「鼓」聲既可聲雄渾有勁，亦能清脆悅耳。梁正傑(Jason)中學時得到恩師周展彤先生的啟蒙，學習中西敲擊樂器，確立了自己的目標和專長，隨後入讀演藝學院深造中國敲擊樂，Jason對絳洲鼓情有獨鍾，2007年創立了「赤煉鼓樂團」，曾得到多個獎項及表演無數，更獲邀到絳洲鼓發源地山西新絳懸(古稱絳洲)表演和交流，Jason更在校園播下種子，教授鼓樂，從而傳承中國鼓樂文化，他希望學生們通過鼓樂，學習『認真』處世、藉樂『尋根』的精神。他亦教授輪椅人士揮棒擊鼓，遠赴山西新絳懸(古稱絳洲)交流，得到團員的關懷協助下，觸動了大家的心靈。「鼓」聲除了凝聚力量，振奮人心，更是連繫心靈的橋樑，用鼓聲打破隔膜，「心鼓共鳴」.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 醫學先鋒
programme.sub-title: 肚內乾坤 恢復平衡 Rebalance The Stomach
programme.desc: 跟隨頂尖研究員，揭開腸胃鮮為人知的力量. 他們的發現是劃時代的，法國腸道微生物菌群「冒險家」祖爾多希，在腸胃和慢性病，或神經精神之間建立聯繫；哈利蘇高更進一步，證明微生物菌群可以用作治療，特別是通過無需一刀一綫的腸道微生物移植手術；而美國專家基爾斯頓蒂利殊則研究腸胃和大腦的聯繫，感恩有整合醫學創新方法的幫助，令長期受到腹痛折磨的病人可以得到治療。. Their findings are revolutionary. Joël Doré, the "adventurer" of the gut microbiota, has established a link between our stomach and chronic or neuropsychiatric diseases; Harry Sokol has gone even further by showing that the microbiota can heal, notably through fecal microbiota transplants; and American Kirsten Tillisch has studied the links between our stomach and our brain and, thanks to the innovative methods of integrative medicine, treats patients suffering from abdominal pain.

programme.sub-title: 第十二集：陳興傑和林曉晴舉辦婚禮
programme.desc: 興傑和曉晴要舉辦婚禮了。林恒升職成了省裏的廳長，工人們得知長山要去廣深參加興傑的婚禮，在不寬裕的情況下仍紛紛給了禮金。林恒夫婦接到婚禮通知，都怕顧家以後會拖累興傑。馬曉雲在林場開了一家理髮店，鳳霞一直在市裏打零工，結婚多年也沒生孩子，被馬曉雲催生.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
31看世界 - 醫學先鋒
programme.sub-title: 肚內乾坤 恢復平衡 Rebalance The Stomach
programme.desc: 跟隨頂尖研究員，揭開腸胃鮮為人知的力量. 他們的發現是劃時代的，法國腸道微生物菌群「冒險家」祖爾多希，在腸胃和慢性病，或神經精神之間建立聯繫；哈利蘇高更進一步，證明微生物菌群可以用作治療，特別是通過無需一刀一綫的腸道微生物移植手術；而美國專家基爾斯頓蒂利殊則研究腸胃和大腦的聯繫，感恩有整合醫學創新方法的幫助，令長期受到腹痛折磨的病人可以得到治療。. Their findings are revolutionary. Joël Doré, the "adventurer" of the gut microbiota, has established a link between our stomach and chronic or neuropsychiatric diseases; Harry Sokol has gone even further by showing that the microbiota can heal, notably through fecal microbiota transplants; and American Kirsten Tillisch has studied the links between our stomach and our brain and, thanks to the innovative methods of integrative medicine, treats patients suffering from abdominal pain.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
唐朝詭事錄
programme.desc: 蘇無名前往文廟探查，吉祥與冬郎揭發獨孤遐叔曾揚言殺害劉有求。蘇無名前往獨孤遐叔府宅探查，鄰居揭發獨孤遐叔夜半磨刀，將輕紅殺害。土地廟中，輕紅的屍體被發現藏於土地公的彩塑之中，獨孤遐叔當場認罪。蘇無名卻認為獨孤遐叔並非兇手.

programme.title: 唐朝詭事錄
programme.desc: 費雞師用針灸之法醫治獨孤遐叔的夢魘症，裴喜君根據獨孤腦中的畫面作成畫。但盧凌風再揭穿獨孤隱藏的秘密，他羞憤撞牆自殺。下屬告知蘇無名要追查的飛賊原來來了南州，劉有求之父自焚而死。是日，打掃文廟的吉祥穿戴一新準備離開文廟，盧凌風立即把他追捕.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 赫伯特為自己栽種的植物感到無比自豪，準備迎接《小矮人園丁終極雜誌》的造訪。然而，一條風龍飛過森林，毀掉了他所有的辛勞成果，他只好孤注一擲——借用臭臭魔法師製造的臭臭堆肥！然而，整片森林都面臨著被惡臭淹沒的危機，英雄們必須設法清除它.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 為了幫助嫲嫲治病，如福侍衛隊到景山尋找蒼耳子。雖然趕走了朝風，但只剩一顆假蒼耳子。大家沮喪時，汪大夫發現滑板樹皮上黏著真正的蒼耳子.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 土地公外出請求灶君帶班一天，子軒偷聽兩人的談話，潛入土地廟，陰差陽錯中損壞了小鎮司南導致小鎮處於失重狀態，兩人不得不歷經艱險，回家找爸爸求助.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 聲音導航
programme.desc: 「鼓」聲既可聲雄渾有勁，亦能清脆悅耳。梁正傑(Jason)中學時得到恩師周展彤先生的啟蒙，學習中西敲擊樂器，確立了自己的目標和專長，隨後入讀演藝學院深造中國敲擊樂，Jason對絳州鼓情有獨鍾，2007年創立了「赤煉鼓樂團」，曾得到多個獎項及表演無數，更獲邀到絳州鼓發源地山西新絳懸(古稱絳州)表演和交流，Jason更在校園播下種子，教授鼓樂，從而傳承中國鼓樂文化，他希望學生們通過鼓樂，學習『認真』處世、藉樂『尋根』的精神。他亦教授輪椅人士揮棒擊鼓，遠赴山西新絳懸(古稱絳州)交流，得到團員的關懷協助下，觸動了大家的心靈。「鼓」聲除了凝聚力量，振奮人心，更是連繫心靈的橋樑，用鼓聲打破隔膜，「心鼓共鳴」.

programme.title: 老家伙
programme.sub-title: 第二集：孫前程向妻子籌集啟動資金
programme.desc: 孫前程展開了籌集啟動資金之路，他的籌款目標不是別人，而是自己的妻子─明舟集團董事長夏明舟。夏明舟白手起家，性格強勢，商場上殺伐決斷。任憑夏明舟如何數落，孫前程也咬定目標不放鬆：「拿500萬出來!」，不然就離婚.

夢想中華人物誌
programme.sub-title: 夢想中華人物誌｜開基創業—李兆基｜社會｜慈善
programme.desc: 李兆基博士憑著非凡的智慧與商業眼光，成功創立以地產為核心的企業。李博士以「聚散之道」管理財富，秉持「搵錢要成功，使錢要成功」的理念，致力回饋社會與國家：興建醫院、捐助學校、設立獎學金，為市民與青年提供機會；同時，他亦放眼神州，透過培華教育基金，長年為國家培育專業人才，影響遍及中華大地，他的付出化成希望，並以生生不息的傳承精神延續下去。.
